text: A May 2024 cleanup removed local aliases of Ci.nsMsgSearchScope, Ci.nsMsgSearchOp and related interfaces across search UI files. In this code, write the qualified Ci member so the source of a constant remains visible. This is a supported local syntax preference based on the landed cleanup, not a claim that all Thunderbird aliases are forbidden.
title: Keep Ci enum names qualified in search code
